shared_elements: human figure(s) with head, torso and arms represented
low-relief carving on a stone surface
repeated small ornamental units in a row
justification: Both surfaces present human-derived forms in shallow relief and both include disc/circle motifs (rosettes in A, concentric rings on the back of the figure in B), but that is the extent of the correspondence. A is a narrative procession frieze of many naturalistically proportioned standing figures in profile, holding hands and carrying objects, framed by rosette bands; B is a single massive schematic frontal head-and-torso block whose reverse bears isolated abstract carvings, with no scene, no procession and no interaction between figures.
